sections.title: Quantitative Methods and Tools for Urban Research
sections.description: This course is an in-depth exploration of quantitative methods and tools fundamental for urban social science research. This course discusses concepts such as significance levels, t-tests, and regression. Additionally, this course provides students, including those with no previous background in R or other programming language, with a basic fluency in R. Concepts will include tabulating data, creating a regression model, and working with spatial data.
